text:
alex: Hey folks — opened a small PR to onboard a new model + tokenizer tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4823. Files: models/catalog.yaml, tokenizer/profiles/gpt-small-cc.json, profiles/quant/gpt-small-cc-8q.yaml. Changed default max_seq to 2048. Can someone review config + tokenizer compatibility? Need an approval for a canary deploy later today.

maria: Looking now. Quick Q — is the tokenizer change backward compatible with existing prompt sets?

alex: Good call. Backwards compatible except for emoji splitting edge-cases; added a migration note in the PR and a small regen script for the eval prompt fixtures.

jon: left a couple inline comments about the seq_len bump and batching heuristics. If we increase to 2048 we should validate steady-state latency at target QPS. Also please add a note about expected KV-cache mem impact.

alex: thanks — added a note and some numbers from local runs (approx +12% mem at 2048 vs 1024 for this model).

ci-bot: Build triggered for PR #4823 — unit tests: tokenizer-compat, profile-load, quant-smoke.

ci-bot: tokenizer-compat FAILED on python 3.10 test/tokenizer_test.py::test_split_edges — failing on emoji sequence case.

sam: I can take the tokenizer test failure. Seen this before, likely a regex edge. Will try a quick fix and push to the branch.

tia: FYI if we fix tests quickly, I can approve and do the canary deploy after 4pm PT. Does that timing work?

sam: pushing a tiny change now, re-runs CI.

ci-bot: Re-run queued.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #4823 (after fix).

maria: Reviewed and left one nit on a comment style, but nothing blocking.

jon: Approved — added a note to watch latency in the first 12h of canary.

alex: Amazing, thanks all. tia — canary at 4:10pm PT works. I'll run the eval suite against the canary and post short perf summary in this thread.

tia: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

alex: (post-canary) quick update — canary looks fine at low traffic, slight latency tail at 95th pct — tracking in console dashboard and will rollback to 1024 if we see regression at scale. Will merge once canary has 6h stable.
